rules.title: Automated employment decision tools (AEDT)
rules.trigger: geography mentions NYC OR talent matching pilots
rules.message: NYC Local Law 144 may require annual bias audit and 10-day candidate notice before using AI in hiring/casting decisions affecting NYC talent. Ship to non-NYC talent first or consult employment counsel.

rules.title: Illinois HB 3773
rules.message: Illinois requires disclosure when AI is used in employment decisions. Ensure job postings and matching workflows include required notices for IL talent.

rules.title: California ADMT (2027)
rules.message: California ADMT effective Jan 2027 — plan pre-use notice, opt-out, and access rights in matching workflows now.

rules.title: DOL 1099 classification
rules.message: Mandatory training or discipline-like scoring can suggest employee status for 1099 talent. Frame as voluntary brand education; never gate bookings on AI scores.

rules.title: TCPA consent
rules.trigger: talent_ai_tolerance is open OR staff track mentions SMS
rules.message: SMS to talent requires TCPA consent, STOP handling, and opt-in at onboarding. Prefer in-app over SMS where possible.

generalCounselNote: Consult B9 employment counsel before piloting talent matching (ROI-08), talent FAQ (NEW-02), or no-show auto-replacement (NEW-20).
